title: Mermaid content
description: A Mermaid Resource's source is an asset (ADR 0142, ADR 0155), as a Markdown Resource's text is: its content is a locator whose URL is /assets/<hash>, naming the source by the SHA-256 of its bytes. Export writes the source to the Aggregate directory's assets/<hash>.mmd while a Resource references it; a Resource keeps no source of its own, no path and no media type.

url.description: A stored source's content id: the SHA-256 of its bytes as unpadded base64url, 43 characters in canonical spelling.
